statements.sql: INSERT INTO film_retention (film_id,basis,watchlist,evidence_json,request_id,observed_at,updated_at) SELECT ?,'watchlist_fact',?,?,CASE WHEN ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_person_authority a, film_person_baseline b WHERE a.id=1 AND a.mode='prepared' AND a.cutover='open' AND a.generation=? AND b.id=1 AND b.state='verified' AND b.reference=?)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projection_run WHERE projection='enrichment' AND lease_id=? AND lease_until>strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_retention) BETWEEN ? AND ?) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_external_id WHERE film_id=? AND scheme='letterboxd' AND value=?) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_external_id WHERE scheme='letterboxd' AND value=?)=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_redirect WHERE from_id=?)) THEN ? END,?,? WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_retention WHERE film_id=? AND basis='watchlist_fact' AND watchlist=? AND evidence_json=? AND request_id=? AND observed_at=?)
